description: This file defines the CoreExtension class for Twig, a templating engine for PHP. It provides core functionalities such as registering token parsers, filters, functions, tests, and operator definitions, as well as utility methods for formatting dates, manipulating strings, arrays, and handling attributes within templates.

classes.name: CoreExtension
classes.description: The CoreExtension class extends Twig's AbstractExtension to provide core functionalities, such as registering token parsers, filters, functions, and tests, as well as utility methods for data formatting and manipulation within Twig templates.
